claims.claim: You need your new address details to update the address on your driving licence.
claims.quote: Change the address on your full or provisional driving licence for free - do it online or by post.
claims.note: The service is changing the licence address, which plainly requires the new address; the 'You need' list itself names the licence and residency but not the address explicitly.

claims.claim: You can use a Government Gateway account to update the address.
claims.note: The text says you need to sign in but never names Government Gateway.

claims.claim: You can use a DVLA online service to update the address.
claims.quote: You’ll need to sign in to use this service. If you do not already have sign in details, you’ll be able to create them.
claims.note: The GOV.UK page offers the online DVLA service with its own sign in.
